headers._comment: connect-src 'self' is NOT optional. Without it the service worker registers and then never activates: its own caches.addAll() during install is a same-origin fetch, default-src 'none' blocks it, install rejects, and the site ships with offline silently not working while every page-level check still passes.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
